question: Who was the second person who joined individual satyagraha movement in 1940?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawahar Lal Nehru**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second person to join the **Individual Satyagraha** movement in 1940 was **Jawaharlal Nehru**.
 
• The **Individual Satyagraha** movement was launched by **Mahatma Gandhi** in 1940 as a peaceful protest against British repression and to assert the right to free speech during World War II.
 
• **Vinoba Bhave** was the **first Satyagrahi** selected by Gandhi to launch this movement.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was chosen as the **second Satyagrahi** to participate in the movement, and he was subsequently arrested for delivering anti-war speeches, which was part of the protest against British involvement of India in World War II without consulting Indian leaders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Subhash Chandra Bose
 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement, known for his radical and militant approach. Unlike Gandhi's non-violent methods, Bose believed in a more confrontation with British rule.
 
 
 
• Muhammad Ali Jinnah
 
 
• Muhammad Ali Jinnah was the leader of the All India Muslim League and a prominent advocate for the creation of Pakistan.
 
• By the 1940s, Jinnah was focused on advancing the idea of a separate Muslim state and distanced himself from the Indian National Congress’s campaigns.
 
 
 
• Vinoba Bhave
 
 
• Vinoba Bhave was the first person selected by Gandhi to initiate the Individual Satyagraha.
 
• Known for his deep commitment to Gandhi’s principles, Bhave’s selection was significant as he represented the moral and spiritual essence of satyagraha.
